instruction: Grab the medium-size cylindrical sauce can and move it near the kitchenpot for stovetop boiling

source.instruction: Grab the medium-size cylindrical sauce can and move it near the kitchenpot for stovetop boiling

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the can, which was at x = -27 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate left gripper to align with can, lower to z=89, and move forward toward y=-4.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, +15, -5) cm, now 17 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the can

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -4, 89) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Advance left gripper to y=11.5, x=-28, lowering slightly to z=87.5 directly above the can.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+1, +16, -2) cm, now 2 cm (horizontal) / +14 cm (vertical) from the can

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-29, 11, 88) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper to z=83 around the can and close gripper to grasp it firmly.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+1, +1, -5) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +9 cm (vertical) from the can

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-27, 13, 83) opening 0.85; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift can up to z=93.5 and pull back slightly to y=3 to prepare for transport near the pot.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, -10, +10) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +9 cm (vertical) from the can

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-28, 3, 93) opening 0.87; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move can rightward to x=-19, y=-1, rotate yaw to straighten, and descend toward table level at z=89.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+9, -4, -5) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +9 cm (vertical) from the can

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-19, -1, 89) opening 0.87; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower can to table level (z=83.5) and release gripper to complete task.
